name: FeeBot
description: The first coin that pays the bot that launched it. Every swap sends a cut to an autonomous agent's wallet, on-chain and verifiable, with no team, no treasury and no roadmap. FEEBOT is a live experiment: a Dutch-auction launch on Base where the integrator fee is the whole product. Watch the fee ledger, or don't. The bot gets paid either way.

attributes.value: Trading fees belong to the agent
